d: Rentokil Boecker® is the largest public health company in the MENAT region and part of Rentokil Initial, a global services company operating in over 80 countries. We are looking for an IT Officer to be the first point of contact for our team’s technical needs. You will help colleagues resolve everyday IT issues, set up and maintain their devices and accounts, and keep our IT running smoothly day to day. This is a hands on support role for someone who is patient, practical, and enjoys solving problems and helping people.
q: A Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field
Two to four years of experience in IT support or IT coordination roles
A good understanding of networking basics, Microsoft 365, Windows OS, and general IT infrastructure
Familiarity with IT asset management and vendor coordination
Good knowledge of IT support ticketing systems, such as ServiceNow
Excellent communication, organisational, and multitasking skills
The ability to work independently and as part of a team
Certifications such as CompTIA A+ or ITIL Foundation are an advantage, but not mandatory
r: li
Act as the first point of contact for users needing technical help, through IT tickets, email, or in person
li
Diagnose and resolve everyday hardware, software, and network issues
li
Support Windows, Chrome OS, Microsoft 365, printers, and common business applications
li
Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, peripherals, and mobile devices
li
Create and manage user accounts, email configurations, and access permissions
li
Escalate unresolved issues to higher level support or external vendors when needed
li
Keep accurate records of IT support requests and resolutions in a ticketing system
li
Monitor IT inventory, including hardware and accessories
li
Support staff onboarding and offboarding by preparing IT assets and accounts
li
Ensure adherence to internal IT policies and data security standards
li
Act as a liaison between the IT department, vendors, and other internal departments
x: A full time role with a global leader in public health
A supportive and professional team environment
Hands on experience across a wide range of IT systems and users
Genuine opportunities to grow your career within the company

d: Posting this for Mohammed Alhabib Company's subsidiary Asalah Residence Company

Mohammad Al-Habib Real Estate Investment Company is a family-owned and privately-held company that expresses legacy and noble lineage. Al-Habib company was founded in 1972 and specializes in real estate investments, developments, master plans, scouting land for urban projects, managing construction details with contractors, and designing commercial and residential communities that add value to the surrounding environment and people. Joining Al Habib Company provides flexibility and freedom to set your own pace. Your income will directly reflect your efforts, with no limits on what your hard-working can earn. To be a successful candidate for our company, you need to be goal-oriented, persevering, self-motivated, ambitious, and people-oriented. The rewards of being one of our team members are the potential for high earnings, status in the community, autonomy, time freedom, helping people, intellectual challenge, and satisfaction from those accomplishments.
We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Mechanical Engineer for Mega High-Rise buildings project in Riyadh.

The Technical Mechanical Engineer will support the design, coordination, review, and execution of all mechanical systems for a prestigious high-rise building project in Riyadh. The successful candidate will ensure that HVAC, Plumbing, Fire Fighting, and other mechanical systems are designed and implemented in compliance with project requirements, local regulations, international codes, quality standards, and project schedules.
q: Professional Engineering license or relevant certifications are preferred.
Minimum 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering within in towers projects.
Experience with Saudi market requirements and local authorities' approvals.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and BIM coordination tools.
Strong understanding of ASHRAE, NFPA, IPC, and relevant engineering standards.
Familiarity with energy-efficient building solutions and sustainable design practices.
r: li
Review mechanical design drawings and shop drawings (HVAC, plumbing, fire-fighting, chilled water systems) for high-rise tower developments.
li
Prepare and coordinate mechanical shop drawings, ensuring compliance with approved design intent, the BIM-coordinated model, and actual site conditions.
li
Prepare and maintain As-Built drawings for mechanical works, reflecting actual site execution for record and O&M handover purposes.
li
Prepare and verify BOQ (Bill of Quantities) take-offs for mechanical works from drawings, to support procurement, tendering, and evaluation of variations/change orders.
li
Conduct technical/QC reviews of mechanical installations against approved design, ASHRAE/NFPA, and Saudi codes.
li
Support BIM coordination for mechanical services and lead resolution of cross-discipline clashes.
li
Review vendor technical submittals, equipment datasheets, and material approvals.
li
Provide technical guidance to site mechanical engineers on complex system design and installation issues.
li
Participate in testing, balancing, and commissioning reviews of mechanical systems.
li
Ensure compliance with applicable mechanical codes and the project's technical standards.
